items: Run Detail shows the run's resource posture at every wait, with gate choices to keep, minimize, or free the slot, and says when a parked run is restored into a different slot.
Recipe replay can target another simulator or device, picked from the machine's device inventory with the platform selector alongside.
The Slot View capability panel shows fleet-scoped claim queues: position, the run holding the claim, and a granted reservation waiting on its provider.
Machine pause and restore surfaces show what each park retains or stops and the restore verdict from the gateway.
Backlog dispatch settings carry the run's wait policy.
